author: Comfygamerguy
quote: Regardless if you like the story or not. This game took 13 years. 13 years to serve 30fps with frame drops into 20s…that alone for me along with glitches is a 5/10. I did not like the story it’s more like a simpulator and the story is awful. Like awful…it’s just silly this isn’t what GTA is about. Totally missed the mark. 0/10.
